text:
Priya: ops-bot alert — eu-west-1 GPU pool queue depth spiked, current queue=240 (threshold=100). dashboard: https://dash.redwood/eu-west-1
ops-bot: [ALERT] pool=eu-west-1-gpu-pool metric=queue_length value=240 threshold=100
Maya: noticing increased tail latency on hosted-api for eu-west-1, customers getting 429s and longer waits
Liam: looks like admission controller didn't start throttling early enough, requests keep queuing onto busy workers
Priya: allocator logs show repeated "no available slot" errors during allocation window, node churn low but slow accepts
Alex: taking quick action: scaling pool replicas +2 and draining low-priority batch jobs from that pool
Maya: ok to scale, but flagging cost — set override to temporary and notify finance if we keep it >24h
Liam: running `kubectl scale deployment/gpu-pool-eu-west1 --replicas=14` now
deploy-bot: scale action accepted — gpu-pool-eu-west1 -> 14 replicas
Priya: rolling out admission controller soft-limit change: earlier cutoff 80% -> now 65% to force earlier rejections/queueing
Maya: can we add per-customer queue breakdown on the dashboard? would speed triage if it's noisy customers
Liam: filed RED-4532 to add per-customer queue metrics + alert refinement: https://tickets/redwood/RED-4532
Priya: queue depth down to ~40, p95 tail latency dropped ~35% after scale + limit change, still watching
Maya: reassigning oncall to @Liam for next 60m, pls monitor dashboards and logs
Liam: will monitor logs and autoscaler behavior; will rollback scale if cost delta > 20% expected
Priya: FYI we saw a brief network flap in az-a around the spike window causing allocation retries — adding to churn
Alex: logging incident notes for postmortem under /incidents/eu-west-1-queue-spike, will include allocator logs and network events
ops-bot: [RECOVERY] pool=eu-west-1-gpu-pool queue_length=38 threshold=100 — alert cleared
Maya: thanks — follow-up: let's schedule a short runbook update to include earlier soft-limit tuning and per-customer surfacing
Priya: agreed, adding runbook checklist to RED-4532 and will ping devex for dashboard widgets
Liam: will keep watch for 2h then promote any config changes to stable if no regressions
Alex: closing the immediate thread, will collect traces for postmortem
deploy-bot: incident ticket created: INC-7891 (eu-west-1 queue spike)
